_doc: Example DCE run config for data that is NOT in BIDS layout. Copy it, point the paths at
your own files, and edit. See dce_run_example_bids.json for the BIDS form.
The data here is tests/data/BBB data p19: one folder of NIfTIs with no BIDS entities, no
sub-/ses- hierarchy and no JSON sidecars -- the shape most studies arrive in. Nothing
about the pipeline requires BIDS. Every input is named outright in the file lists below,
so the layout on disk is irrelevant: the folders could be named anything.
Compared to BIDS, all file names have to be given explicitly, and the
acquisition parameters have to be stated. 'tr_ms', 'fa_deg' and 'time_resolution_sec'
would otherwise come from <subject_source_path>/dce/*DCE.json, and 'relaxivity' has no
default anywhere, so it must be given here or the run stops.
If you do have a metadata JSON but not the BIDS folder layout, name it with
stage_overrides.dce_metadata_path instead of restating the values, or put it beside the
dynamic image with a matching name and it will be read and the values will be used.
